flows.description: action inputs 与 secrets 通过 INPUT_* 环境变量注入（连字符/下划线兼容）
注入 ATOMGIT_REF_NAME/RUN_ID/SHA、ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL、workspace 路径
传入 config-file 路径，返回合并后的 DEFAULT_CONFIG + 用户配置
findGitRoot 向上查 .git，调用 git remote get-url / rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
pip install --break-system-packages lizard -i mirrors.aliyun.com --trusted-host
传入 config 与 scan options（sourceDir、upload、gitUrl、branchName、pipelineRunId、commitId）
调用 scc 统计代码规模，返回 slocResult
调用 lizard 计算函数复杂度，返回 lizardResult
传入 slocResult 作分母，返回 duplicationResult
传入 formattedMetrics + 元数据，返回 {success, obsUrl, recordId}
写本地 metrics.json（剥离 snapshotData + 裁剪超长 content）
调用 scc 二进制 + 后置 FileCollector.isPathExcluded 过滤
写 lizard_input.txt 调用 python3 -m lizard，再读源文件计算函数体 nloc
lizard 输入文件 + lizard_output.json
逐文件读取（含二进制嗅探），跨文件行级匹配
递归遍历，跳过 . 前缀目录，按 exclude-dirs/allowed-extensions 过滤
全量 payload 写 tmp JSON，上传后清理
execFileSync obsutil cp + STS 临时凭证或静态 AK/SK
/metrics/code/report，OIDC 模式 callApig 或 AK/SK 模式 axios.post + ApigSigner
OIDC ID Token → STS 临时凭证 + V11 签名（SDK 内部）
传入 {method, url, headers, body}，返回带 Authorization 的 headers
execSync bash 下载 obsutil_linux_amd64.tar.gz 并解压、chmod 755

threats.title: PIPELINE_RUN_ID environment variable override of run identity
threats.description: User can set PIPELINE_RUN_ID env var to override the true ATOMGIT_RUN_ID, causing metrics to be attributed to the wrong pipeline.
threats.mitigation: Prefer ATOMGIT_RUN_ID; if PIPELINE_RUN_ID fallback is required, add whitelist validation or opt-out flag.

threats.title: pip install lizard 120s timeout blocking on slow PyPI mirror
threats.description: pip install --break-system-packages lizard 120s timeout + stdio:'inherit' blocking; a malicious or slow PyPI mirror response can exhaust runner resources.
threats.mitigation: Use execFileSync + --no-input + --require-hashes; reduce timeout to 60s; do not block scan on failure.

threats.title: OIDC URL presence-only check allows forged OIDC provider
threats.description: useOidc = !!process.env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL relies only on env var existence; attacker controlling runner env can inject forged URL to call attacker-controlled OIDC provider.
threats.mitigation: Validate ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL starts with https:// and host is on GitCode platform whitelist; SDK should do issuer validation.

threats.title: core.info leaks commitId and gitUrl to console logs
threats.description: core.info outputs gitUrl/branchName/pipelineRunId/commitId to console logs; commitId can be cross-referenced to track individual developer behavior.
threats.mitigation: Only output redacted pipelineRunId; move commitId and gitUrl to debug level (verbose=true only).

threats.title: Scan failures emit only core.warning without audit log
threats.description: scan failures emit core.warning only (no structured audit log);事后无法追溯是谁触发了失败/异常.
threats.mitigation: Add audit log reporting to independent endpoint (pipelineRunId + commitId + failure reason), decoupled from metrics upload.

threats.title: getInput tolerates hyphen/underscore INPUT_* forms allowing env override of secrets
threats.description: getInput() supports both hyphen and underscore forms of INPUT_<NAME>; if CI platform env block allows PR comment/branch name to inject env vars, malicious user can construct INPUT_APIG_APP_KEY to override secret input.
threats.mitigation: For security-related inputs (apig-app-key/secret, obs-ak/sk), explicitly verify input source is from workflow secrets context.

threats.title: JSON.stringify(compactResult) can exceed V8 string length limit
threats.description: 超 large repo + high duplication rate can trigger JSON.stringify(compactResult) exceeding V8 single string limit (Invalid string length).
threats.mitigation: Cap fileDetails or use streaming writes; monitor JSON.stringify exceptions and degrade to chunked file writes.

threats.title: logger.info leaks file scale info to console
threats.description: logger.info outputs 'Local output size approx: ${JSON.stringify(compactResult).length} bytes' + 'Result scale: fileDetails=..., snapshotDataTotal=... bytes', leaking file scale info.
threats.mitigation: Avoid output when verbose=false; reduce log noise.

threats.title: catch block failure path has no structured audit log
threats.description: catch block (scanner.js:197-225) on failure only does logger.error + retry upload; logger is winston console transport, no audit persistence.
threats.mitigation: Failure fallback upload already includes errorMessage; add structured errorReport field with stack head (12 lines) and persist to audit endpoint.

threats.title: toRelativePath strips sources prefix allowing workspace-escaping paths
threats.description: toRelativePath() uses sources as prefix for剥除; malicious sources=['/tmp'] allows absolute path prefix matching /tmp/secret.txt to be stripped to secret.txt and reported.
threats.mitigation: Constrain sources to within workspace (path.resolve(this.workingDir, src)) before prefix stripping.

threats.title: execSync maxBuffer 100MB + timeout 300s vulnerable to adversarial file count
threats.description: execSync maxBuffer: 100*1024*1024 + timeout: 300000; maliciously crafted many files can trigger scc output > 100MB and throw error (caught, fallback iterates all files).
threats.mitigation: Add hard cap on file count (e.g., 100k); reject scan and prompt user to split repo when exceeded.

threats.title: Bundled scc binary compromise via supply chain attack
threats.description: Bundled scc binary dist/bin/scc on Linux first run fs.chmodSync(candidate, 0o755); if dist packaging is compromised (supply chain attack) injecting malicious scc, can execute arbitrary code with runner privileges.
threats.mitigation: SBOM validation or hash signing for scc binary; CI build records sha256 and verifies at runtime.

threats.title: console.log leaks scc command line and absolute file paths
threats.description: console.log outputs scc command line + file paths; maliciously crafted filePath containing sensitive paths (e.g., /etc/secrets/...) can enter logs.
threats.mitigation: Only output relative paths to scan root, not absolute paths.

threats.title: scc binary path spoofing via ancestor directory candidates
threats.description: getSccPath() probes path.join(__dirname, 'bin', 'scc') and several ancestor directories; if malicious checkout injects same-named scc binary into ancestor directory, can be优先 selected and executed.
threats.mitigation: Strictly use path.join(bundleRoot, 'bin', 'scc') single source; candidate paths must not include ancestor directories.

threats.title: Command injection via shell concatenation in runScc
threats.description: runScc() uses const cmd = '"${this.sccPath}" ${args.join(" ")}' + execSync(cmd) string concatenation; if this.sccPath or sources path contains shell metacharacters ($(...), ; rm), can trigger command injection.
threats.mitigation: Use execFileSync(this.sccPath, args, ...) parameter array, bypassing shell; sources path normalized with fs.realpathSync.

threats.title: pip install --break-system-packages pollutes system Python
threats.description: pip install lizard --break-system-packages system-level install; if runner has other workflow steps using python3, they will be polluted with this lizard version.
threats.mitigation: Use venv isolation (python3 -m venv /tmp/lizard-venv && source /tmp/lizard-venv/bin/activate && pip install lizard).

threats.title: execSync maxBuffer 50MB + timeout 300s vulnerable to function count DoS
threats.description: execSync maxBuffer: 50*1024*1024 + timeout: 300000; malicious repo with many functions (e.g., generated code templates) can trigger lizard output > 50MB.
threats.mitigation: Batch files for lizard (N files per batch); or monitor output size and degrade to sampling above threshold.

threats.title: fs.readFileSync of untrusted lizard output filePath allows arbitrary file read
threats.description: runLizard's fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8') + fs.readFileSync(func.filename, 'utf8') allows reading any file readable by runner process; malicious lizard output can let func.filename = '/etc/passwd' be read.
threats.mitigation: Same as T04.I: validate func.filename must be within workspace scope.

threats.title: Arbitrary file read via untrusted lizard output filePath
threats.description: parseTextOutput regex captures filePath as group 9; malicious lizard output can let filePath point to sensitive file, triggering fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8') reading content into functions[].filename, eventually entering metrics.json and OBS upload.
threats.mitigation: Validate filePath must be within sources/workspace scope, otherwise skip that function; or sign lizard output.

threats.title: Lizard temp output file spoofing via workspace root path
threats.description: tempJsonFile = './lizard_output.json' default writes to workspace root; malicious repo can pre-place same-named file. Although code does unlinkSync first, malicious pre-placed file can still be read when runLizard fails.
threats.mitigation: Write tempJsonFile to os.tmpdir() (consistent with writeInputFile), avoiding workspace pollution.

threats.title: Command injection via TMPDIR-controlled path in execSync lizard
threats.description: execSync('python3 -m lizard ' + args.join(' ')) string concatenation; args includes tempInputPath and tempJsonPath. If attacker controls TMPDIR env var, can inject path with shell metacharacters.
threats.mitigation: Use execFileSync('python3', ['-m', 'lizard', '-f', tempInputPath, '-o', tempJsonPath], ...) parameter array; validate os.tmpdir() does not contain special characters.

threats.title: Path traversal via malicious gitUrl in extractOwnerRepo affecting objectKey
threats.description: buildObjectKey uses ownerRepo to splice objectKey, but extractOwnerRepo uses regex (?:git@[^:]+:|https?://[^/]+/)(.+)$ to extract; malicious gitUrl containing ../ can let ownerRepo contain path traversal segments, making objectKey write to other owner's directory.
threats.mitigation: extractOwnerRepo should replace /\.\./g and limit / count; or backend should authenticate by owner before downloading.

threats.title: Cross-file union-find O(n^2) complexity on adversarial input
threats.description: Cross-file union-find sliding window matching (detectWithLineLevel) algorithm complexity may be O(n^2) or higher (n=total file lines); maliciously crafted many duplicate blocks can trigger CPU exhaustion.
threats.mitigation: Add hard cap on single file line count (e.g., 100k lines); skip duplication detection for that file and warn when exceeded.

threats.title: Source code snippets in snapshotData transit to OBS via metrics pipeline
threats.description: fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8') reads full source file content; buildContextSegments builds ±5 line context segments (snapshotData) containing plaintext code, eventually encoded Base64 and uploaded to OBS (private object).
threats.mitigation: Already mitigated by Base64 encoding + OBS private object; if scanned repo source contains keys/PII, keys will transit this link. Recommend upstream gitleaks/detect-private-key hook interception; optional: regex mask suspected keys in snapshotData before upload.

threats.title: Unbounded config file size can exhaust runner memory
threats.description: 超 large config file can exhaust runner memory (no max size limit).
threats.mitigation: fs.statSync to validate file size before loading (e.g., < 1MB); reject if exceeded.

threats.title: mergeConfig allows user override of security-critical fields
threats.description: mergeConfig recursive merge; user can override detectors.duplication.enabled=false or uploader.coderepoUrl etc. security-related fields in config-file (although coderepoUrl hardcoded in index.js overrides, enabled field can be disabled).
threats.mitigation: Whitelist merge for security-related fields (enabled, url, credentials); or validate key fields not modified by userConfig after loading.

threats.title: YAML anchor/alias cycle can trigger stack overflow
threats.description: yaml.load(fileContent) uses js-yaml ^4.1.0; default SAFE_SCHEMA does not support !!js/function etc. unsafe types; but if user config-file contains malicious YAML anchor/alias cycle, can trigger stack overflow.
threats.mitigation: Upgrade to latest js-yaml; or limit config-file size (e.g., < 1MB); explicitly set schema: yaml.DEFAULT_SAFE_SCHEMA when loading.

threats.title: Unbounded directory recursion can trigger stack overflow
threats.description: 超 deep directory recursion (e.g., maliciously crafted 1000-level nested directories) can trigger stack overflow; _walkDir recursive call has no depth limit.
threats.mitigation: Add maxDepth parameter (e.g., 32); skip subdirectory when exceeded.

threats.title: console.warn leaks absolute path of runner filesystem
threats.description: console.warn('[WARN] 路径不存在: ${absolutePath}') and console.warn('[WARN] 文件扩展名不在允许列表中: ${absolutePath}') output absolute paths, potentially leaking runner filesystem structure.
threats.mitigation: Output relative paths (relative to this.workingDir) instead of absolute paths.

threats.title: ReDoS via user-supplied glob patterns in globToRegExp
threats.description: globToRegExp(glob) converts user exclude-dirs patterns to regex; maliciously crafted glob patterns (e.g., (a+)+ backtracking patterns) can trigger ReDoS, blocking _walkDir.
threats.mitigation: Use safe-regex library to pre-validate regex after glob conversion; or set hard timeout for single _walkDir.

threats.title: Path traversal via malicious gitUrl in buildObjectKey
threats.description: buildObjectKey uses extractOwnerRepo(options.gitUrl) to splice objectKey; malicious gitUrl containing ../ can let ownerRepo path traverse, making OBS objectKey write to other owner's directory; backend may read attacker-crafted malicious data when downloading by objectKey.
threats.mitigation: extractOwnerRepo validates ownerRepo does not contain .., //, etc.; or backend authenticates by owner before downloading.

threats.title: execFileSync obsutil has no timeout, can block indefinitely
threats.description: execFileSync(obsutil, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }) has no timeout; slow OBS endpoint response or network failure can block indefinitely.
threats.mitigation: Add timeout: 60000 (60s); clean up tmpFile and return failure on timeout.

threats.title: AK/SK static credential leak enables forged APIG signatures
threats.description: AK/SK mode ApigSigner(this.apigAppKey, this.apigAppSecret); if SK leaks (logs, tmp files, git history), attacker can forge signatures to directly call /openlibing-coderepo/metrics/code/report and upload forged data (overwriting real metrics).
threats.mitigation: Force OIDC mode (deprecate AK/SK); or IP whitelist for AK/SK; monitor abnormal upload sources.

threats.title: obsutil command line log leaks -i=STS_AK/OBS_AK access key ID
threats.description: console.log('[upload] exec obsutil ${maskedArgs.join(" ")}') outputs command line; -k=***/-t=*** are masked but -i=STS_AK/-i=OBS_AK are not masked; accessKeyId (temporary or permanent AK) enters logs.
threats.mitigation: Also mask -i= (show only first 4 chars + ***); or do not output obsutil command line at all, only output obsutil version + result.

threats.title: Upload failure console.error has no structured audit
threats.description: report() on failure does console.error('Upload error: ${error.code || error.message}, URL: ${url}') to stdout, no structured audit.
threats.mitigation: Add structured errorReport reporting (pipelineRunId + commitId + failure reason + timestamp) to independent endpoint.

threats.title: Command injection via TMPDIR-controlled path in ensureObsutil
threats.description: ensureObsutil() uses execSync('wget -q "${downloadUrl}" -O "${tarball}" 2>/dev/null || curl -sL "${downloadUrl}" -o "${tarball}"', { shell: '/bin/bash' }); downloadUrl is hardcoded but tarball/extractedDir contains os.tmpdir() path; if TMPDIR is controlled by attacker with shell metacharacter path, can trigger command injection.
threats.mitigation: Use execFileSync('wget', ['-q', downloadUrl, '-O', tarball]) parameter array; or use Node.js built-in https.get to download.

threats.title: _canonicalUri trailing slash can trigger unintended APIG routes
threats.description: _canonicalUri(uri) appends / at end (aligned with official SDK); but if some APIG routes are sensitive to trailing / (e.g., redirect to different handler), can be triggered by crafted path to unintended route.
threats.mitigation: Only for known APIG routes (/metrics/code/report); route whitelist; non-whitelist path rejects signing.

threats.title: Unbounded URL/query processing can trigger CPU exhaustion
threats.description: _canonicalUri/_canonicalQueryString/_urlEncode are all string processing;超 long URL or超 many query parameters can trigger CPU exhaustion.
threats.mitigation: Add upper limit validation for URL length and query parameter count.

threats.title: Empty ak/sk produces anonymous-style Authorization header
threats.description: ApigSigner constructor does not validate ak/sk non-empty; if caller passes empty string, sign() outputs 'Access=, SignedHeaders=..., Signature=...', may be treated as anonymous request by APIG (depending on gateway config).
threats.mitigation: Constructor validates 'if (!ak || !sk) throw new Error("ApigSigner requires ak/sk")'; CoderepoUploader.report already has AK/SK mode validation.

threats.title: Authorization header exposes ak in cleartext
threats.description: headers['Authorization'] = 'SDK-HMAC-SHA256 Access=${this.ak}, SignedHeaders=..., Signature=...'; ak (access key ID) plaintext in Authorization header; if caller outputs headers to logs, ak will leak.
threats.mitigation: Caller (CoderepoUploader.report) already uses axios without outputting headers; but console.error outputs URL (not headers). Recommend ak masking in debug logs inside sign().

threats.title: decodeURIComponent can throw URIError on malformed URL
threats.description: sign() parses URL (new URL(url)) + decodes query string; maliciously crafted URL with超 long query or special characters can trigger decodeURIComponent exception or URIError, causing signing failure.
threats.mitigation: Add upper limit validation for URL length (e.g., < 8KB); wrap decodeURIComponent in try/catch (already has but only throws).

threats.title: High-duplication repo abuse can saturate OBS upload and backend ingestion
threats.description: Attacker crafts high-duplication files (e.g., 1000 10-line identical code blocks) can trigger large data volume in upload pipeline; although OBS transit mitigates APIG 12MB limit, OBS upload cost and backend ingestion pressure can be abused.
threats.mitigation: Cap duplicationOccurrences count (e.g., 1000); truncate and warn when exceeded.

threats.title: Adversarial file count/size can exhaust runner resources
threats.description: Maliciously crafted超 many files (e.g., 1M empty files) or超 large files can exhaust runner resources (disk/memory/CPU).
threats.mitigation: Add hard caps on file count and single file size; reject scan when exceeded.

threats.title: Source code content transits metrics pipeline to OBS
threats.description: WorkspaceRepo contains all source code of scanned repo (including possible keys/PII); after SlocDetector/LizardDetector/DuplicationDetector read, fileDetails and duplicationOccurrences content will enter metrics.json and OBS upload.
threats.mitigation: Upstream gitleaks + detect-private-key hooks already configured (.pre-commit-config.yaml); optional: regex mask keys in fileDetails content before upload.

threats.title: output path can be crafted to overwrite other workflow step inputs
threats.description: output path can be crafted as runner上 other workflow step's input file (e.g., .gitcode/workflows/pre-commit.yml referenced file), overwriting it affects subsequent step behavior.
threats.mitigation: Same as T11.T: validate output path must be within workspace subdirectory.

threats.title: 超 large metrics.json can trigger V8 Invalid string length
threats.description: 超 large metrics.json can trigger V8 Invalid string length (mitigated by clipOversizeContent 15KB裁剪 duplicationOccurrences), but fileDetails list itself can be超 long.
threats.mitigation: Also batch or裁剪 fileDetails; or use streaming write (fs.createWriteStream + JSON.stringify alternative).

threats.title: metrics.json content leaks scanned repo structure
threats.description: metrics.json content contains fileDetails (filePath + line counts + complexity + duplication rate) + duplicationOccurrences metadata (groupId/startLine/endLine/content after裁剪), no full source but still leaks repo structure.
threats.mitigation: Default output to private path within workspace; or相对 path化 sensitive fields (e.g., filePath).

threats.title: output parameter path traversal can overwrite arbitrary files
threats.description: output parameter can be crafted as arbitrary path (e.g., /etc/cron.d/malicious); FileUtils.writeJsonFile does fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }) creating directory and writing file, may overwrite runner上 other workflow step's output.
threats.mitigation: Validate output path must be within ${workspace}/ scope; default value metrics.json is already relative path.

threats.title: TMPDIR env var redirect can write temp files to attacker-readable location
threats.description: TMPDIR env var can be set by malicious workflow to redirect to attacker-controlled directory (e.g., /home/attacker/tmp); temp files will be written to attacker-readable location.
threats.mitigation: Do not trust TMPDIR env var; hardcode use of /tmp (Linux) or os.tmpdir() default.

threats.title: tmpdir space can be exhausted by malicious workflow step
threats.description: tmpdir space can be exhausted by malicious workflow step (filling /tmp), causing tmp file write failure.
threats.mitigation: Check fs.statSync(os.tmpdir()) available space before writing; degrade to .tmp directory within workspace when insufficient.

threats.title: Failed unlinkSync leaves full metrics payload residue
threats.description: tmp full payload file contains fileDetails full details + duplicationOccurrences plaintext content (Base64 encoded but decodes to plaintext); if fs.unlinkSync cleanup fails (already try/catch), can residue to next run.
threats.mitigation: Warn on unlink failure; clean up immediately after upload; optional: create tmp files with 0600 permissions.

threats.title: Predictable tmp filename enables race condition and audit trail clearing
threats.description: os.tmpdir() shared by all workflow steps on runner (/tmp); malicious step can pre-place code-metrics-*.json or lizard_input_*.txt files to pollute next run (race condition).
threats.mitigation: Use mkstemp or fs.mkdtempSync to create exclusive directory for tmp files; add random suffix to filename (already uses Date.now() but ms granularity predictable).

threats.title: Path traversal via ownerRepo in objectKey
threats.description: buildObjectKey splices code-metrics-action/${ownerRepo}/${pipelineRunId}/${ts}-metrics.json; attacker controlling ownerRepo containing ../ can let objectKey write to other owner's directory.
threats.mitigation: extractOwnerRepo validates ownerRepo does not contain .., //, empty segments; or backend authenticates by owner before downloading.

threats.title: AK/SK static credential leak enables arbitrary bucket access
threats.description: AK/SK mode obs-ak/obs-sk static credentials (永久 valid); if leaked, attacker can arbitrarily read/write openlibing-gitcode-action bucket (overwrite real metrics or read other owner data).
threats.mitigation: Force OIDC + STS temporary credentials mode; or IP whitelist for AK/SK; bucket-level ACL restrictions.

threats.title: objectKey contains ownerRepo/pipelineRunId can be guessed
threats.description: Private object, but objectKey contains ownerRepo/pipelineRunId; can be guessed; attacker controlling ownerRepo can craft objectKey path traversal.
threats.mitigation: objectKey does not contain sensitive info (only metadata + repo owner); backend authenticates by owner when downloading.

threats.title: DNS spoofing or MitM can forge OBS endpoint
threats.description: Attacker controlling DNS or network MitM can forge obs.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com endpoint, receiving uploaded payload data (including repo source snippets).
threats.mitigation: Force HTTPS + certificate pinning (obsutil already supports); or hash validation for OBS endpoint.

threats.title: MitM can tamper uploaded content
threats.description: If uploaded content is tampered by MitM, backend will get wrong data when downloading by objectKey (forged metrics).
threats.mitigation: OBS server-side validates ETag/MD5; read back after upload to verify hash.

threats.title: OIDC SDK vulnerability can be abused to bypass APIG authentication
threats.description: V11-HMAC-SHA256 signing (OIDC mode) handled by @openlibing/huaweicloud-oidc-client SDK 0.0.5; if SDK implementation has缺陷 (e.g., replay attack window not limited), can be abused to bypass APIG authentication.
threats.mitigation: Upgrade SDK to latest; SDK should do nonce + timestamp validation; monitor abnormal signature requests.

threats.title: AK/SK leak enables forged SDK-HMAC-SHA256 signatures
threats.description: AK/SK mode SK leak后, attacker can forge SDK-HMAC-SHA256 signature to directly call /openlibing-coderepo/metrics/code/report and upload forged data (overwriting real metrics or polluting historical trends).
threats.mitigation: Force OIDC mode; APIG configure IP whitelist; monitor abnormal upload frequency and source.

threats.title: APIG failure response may contain sensitive error message
threats.description: Failure response may contain sensitive error message (resData?.msg || resData?.message), output to console.error.
threats.mitigation: Mask failure response (do not output raw msg, only output code and short description).

threats.title: DNS spoofing or MitM can forge APIG endpoint
threats.description: Attacker controlling DNS or network MitM can forge APIG endpoint (coderepoUrl hardcoded), receiving signed report requests (including metadata + obsUrl).
threats.mitigation: Force HTTPS + certificate pinning; axios already validates TLS certificate.

threats.title: MitM can tamper APIG response, misleading recordId extraction
threats.description: Response can be tampered by MitM, but code already validates resData?.code !== 200; recordId extraction logic is permissive (multiple field attempts), may be misled by crafted response.
threats.mitigation: Strictly validate response schema; recordId must be numeric string with reasonable length.

threats.title: huaweicloud-oidc-client SDK version pinned without vulnerability monitoring
threats.description: @openlibing/huaweicloud-oidc-client SDK 0.0.5 version固定 (package.json:15), no version upgrade or dependency vulnerability scanning; if this version has known vulnerability (e.g., OIDC nonce validation missing), can be abused to bypass authentication.
threats.mitigation: Upgrade SDK to latest; integrate dependabot/renovate for dependency vulnerability monitoring.

threats.title: permissions:id-token:write + forged URL enables OIDC path hijack
threats.description: ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL is runner-injected env var (dist/index.js:62363); useOidc determined only by presence; malicious workflow can declare permissions: id-token: write but also inject forged URL, making plugin go through OIDC path to attacker-controlled endpoint.
threats.mitigation: Same as T15.S: validate URL must be on GitCode platform whitelist.

threats.title: STS credentials visible in ps output via -i/-k/-t command line args
threats.description: STS credentials (cred.accessKeyId/secretAccessKey/securityToken) passed to obsutil via -i/-k/-t command line args, may be visible in ps output (CI platform masks secrets but local ps可见).
threats.mitigation: obsutil supports -i/-k/-t from environment variables (avoid command line args); or use obsutil config file.

threats.title: Forged ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL enables OIDC provider spoofing
threats.description: Attacker controlling runner env (e.g., malicious self-hosted runner config) can inject forged ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL, making callApig/getCredentials call attacker-controlled 'OIDC provider', getting forged STS credentials后 writing to attacker-controlled OBS bucket.
threats.mitigation: Validate ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL must start with https:// and host must be on GitCode platform whitelist; SDK should do issuer validation internally.

threats.title: MitM can tamper STS credentials response
threats.description: STS credentials response can be tampered by MitM (replacing accessKeyId/secretAccessKey with attacker credentials).
threats.mitigation: SDK internally uses HTTPS + certificate validation; STS credentials expire immediately after use (short-lived).

threats.title: Downloaded obsutil has no SBOM validation, supply chain risk
threats.description: downloadUrl hardcoded; user cannot configure; downloaded obsutil has no SBOM validation, supply chain risk.
threats.mitigation: Use OBS Node.js SDK (@huaweicloud/huaweicloud-obs) replacing external obsutil; or hash signature verification for downloaded binary.

threats.title: Download failure fallback to system obsutil can block
threats.description: Download failure fallback to system obsutil; if system obsutil does not exist, throws error; maliciously crafted network jitter can trigger download timeout blocking.
threats.mitigation: Set download timeout (e.g., 60s); do not block on failure, degrade to OBS SDK direct upload.

threats.title: Download URL + tarball/extractedDir path leaked to logs
threats.description: Download URL + tarball/extractedDir path output to logs, leaking runner filesystem structure.
threats.mitigation: Output relative paths or mask tmpdir paths.

threats.title: DNS spoofing can forge obsutil download mirror endpoint
threats.description: Public HTTPS download source; attacker can initiate request without authentication; if controlling DNS can forge endpoint to return malicious obsutil binary.
threats.mitigation: HTTPS certificate validation already mitigates; optional: sha256 validation for downloaded obsutil (known official hash).

threats.title: MitM can replace downloaded tar.gz with malicious obsutil
threats.description: Downloaded tar.gz can be tampered by MitM to malicious obsutil (HTTPS mitigates, but CA trust chain外 risk); after extraction chmod 755 + execFileSync execution, malicious binary can gain runner process privileges.
threats.mitigation: sha256 validation for downloaded file; or use OBS SDK (Node.js built-in) replacing obsutil binary.

threats.title: --break-system-packages system-level install pollutes subsequent workflow steps
threats.description: --break-system-packages system-level install; if runner has other workflow step also using python3, will be polluted with this lizard version, affecting subsequent step behavior.
threats.mitigation: Use venv isolation (python3 -m venv /tmp/lizard-venv && source /tmp/lizard-venv/bin/activate && pip install lizard).

threats.title: pip install 120s timeout can block; failure only warns
threats.description: pip install timeout 120s; malicious mirror slow response can block; failure only warns (line 62476-62478) does not block scan, but lizard missing will cause LizardDetector failure.
threats.mitigation: Reduce timeout to 60s; on failure clearly inform user lizard unavailable + skip lizard detection.

threats.title: --trusted-host skips TLS cert verification enabling MitM injection
threats.description: --trusted-host mirrors.aliyun.com skips TLS certificate verification; network-positioned attacker can initiate MitM to inject malicious lizard package, leading to arbitrary code execution (runner process privileges, may further access secrets).
threats.mitigation: Remove --trusted-host; use HTTPS + certificate verification; or interface with Huawei Cloud internal PyPI mirror (VPC内 trusted).

threats.title: pip install stdio:inherit leaks package metadata to console
threats.description: pip install command stdio: 'inherit' outputs to console, may leak package name, version, download URL.
threats.mitigation: Use stdio: 'pipe' + only output errors on failure; only output short summary on success.

threats.title: Public PyPI mirror accepts unauthenticated package uploads
threats.description: Public HTTPS PyPI mirror; attacker can upload lizard package without authentication (needs mirrors.aliyun.com account); if mirror is compromised can inject malicious lizard package.
threats.mitigation: pip has --trusted-host enabled but skips certificate validation (weakening TLS); use official PyPI + do not skip certificate validation.

threats.title: MitM can tamper downloaded lizard package
threats.description: Downloaded lizard package can be tampered by MitM (--trusted-host mirrors.aliyun.com skips certificate validation); malicious lizard can execute arbitrary Python code (runner process privileges).
threats.mitigation: Remove --trusted-host; use --require-hashes + lizard package hash whitelist; or use venv isolation.
